steps: Измельчить подготовленное филе трески.

Замочить пшеничный хлеб в воде, отжать и повторно измельчить вместе с рыбой; добавить йодированную соль, сливочное масло, сырое яйцо и оставшуюся воду. Источник фиксирует общий расход воды и масла, но не делит его по операциям.

activation.mixed_active_inactive: Fail closed with zero writes; do not silently reactivate a deliberately deactivated recipe.
activation.failure_rollback: Any activation failure rolls back the whole activation UoW; exact inactive publications remain.
activation.required_runtime_seam: The runtime PR must extract/add transaction-neutral prepared-activation policy plus an in-scope batch activation mutation. Existing commit-owning single-recipe activation may remain for its current callers but must not be looped for R3-A.
activation.preflight_before_first_write: Reconcile all 10 exact RecipeVersions + prepared authorities and verify one homogeneous activation state. For all-inactive activation, every candidate must have exact positive prepared energy and Planner admission blocked only by INACTIVE before the first activation write.
activation.write_semantics: Open one caller-owned RecipeCatalogue UoW, stage is_active=true for all 10 through a non-committing in-scope mutation, and perform no inner commits.
activation.precommit_validation: All fallible activation-policy/Planner-admission validation for the would-be active batch must complete before the single commit, using transaction-aware/in-scope evaluation or an equivalent deterministic policy over the staged active state.
activation.post_commit_readback: Read-only/assertive verification only; it is not a second business gate and must not trigger compensating per-recipe deactivation.
